train_analogy_regressor_main: train an analogy regressor model from an HDF5 training file with base classes and cachedir
cluster_feats: cluster features from an HDF5 file by base classes using torch kmeans and cache centroids
mine_analogies: mine analogy relationships between cluster centroids by computing normalized difference vectors and cosine similarity
do_generate: generate new synthetic features and labels using a trained analogy generator to augment training data
init_generator: initialize an AnalogyRegressor model from a saved generator file and load it onto the GPU
